name: ROS2-Humble-Env for OperaSim
postCreateCommand: rosdep update && for ws in /workspaces/*/; do if [ -d "${ws}src" ]; then cd "${ws}" && rosdep install -i --from-path src --rosdistro humble -y && colcon build --symlink-install; fi; done && echo 'for setup_file in /workspaces/*/install/setup.bash; do if [ -f "$setup_file" ]; then source "$setup_file"; fi; done' >> ~/.bashrc
